title: Egyptian authorities board up the paw and drill misleading holes

tellings.quote: down there and the Egyptian authorities came through and they boarded up the front of the Paw with boards literal boards and blocked it off

plain: In the 1990s, Egyptian authorities are said to have come to the Sphinx at Giza and blocked off the front of one of its paws with literal wooden boards, and to have drilled holes that misled people about what lay below. A guest named Matt LaCroix tells Michels this without naming a source, linking it to radar findings of cut empty spaces under the Sphinx. If true, it would mean officials were hiding something beneath the monument.
